project_metadata.app_type: enterprise ESG sustainability data platform dashboard
project_metadata.target_audience: ESG Managers, Sustainability Directors, Compliance Auditors

key_functionalities: Row hover behavior and contextual actions
Sophisticated status badges with subtle check icons
Clear date/time hierarchy for Last Updated column
Layered page background hierarchy for enterprise SaaS character

layout_hierarchy.layer_2_toolbar_card: bg-stone-50/90 border border-stone-200/80 rounded-md shadow-2xs p-4 mb-4
layout_hierarchy.layer_3_table_surface: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-md shadow-xs overflow-hidden
layout_hierarchy.layer_4_rows: bg-white border-b border-stone-100 hover:bg-emerald-50/20 transition-colors duration-150

row_spacing_spec.height_increase: Increase vertical breathing room by 6-10px compared to standard dense tables

status_badge_spec.completed: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200/60 shadow-2xs

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply subtle tonal layer hierarchy: Page background (bg-stone-100/70) -> Toolbar card surface (bg-stone-50) -> Table container (bg-white border-stone-200) -> Rows.
Increase table row vertical height by 6-10px using py-3.5 px-4 cell padding for comfortable enterprise scanning.
Implement row hover with an almost imperceptible tint change (hover:bg-emerald-50/20 or hover:bg-stone-50/80) and make action icons/buttons transition from opacity-50 to opacity-100 on hover.
Format the Last Updated column into a two-line hierarchy: Line 1 (16 Jul 2026, text-xs font-medium text-stone-800) and Line 2 (02:42 pm, text-[11px] text-stone-400).

Refactor Status badges to use light green background (bg-emerald-50), dark forest green text (text-emerald-800), subtle border (border-emerald-200/60), minimal rounded corners (rounded-md), and a small SVG check icon (✓ / CheckCircle). Avoid overly saturated alerts.
Enhance Category cell hierarchy: Primary category title in 14px semibold dark forest-green/slate, Subcategory metadata in 12-13px muted grey with tight line height and optional tiny category icon.
Style table headers with small label typography: uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-semibold text-stone-500 with proper column padding.
Ensure all interactive buttons, rows, table headers, and status badges include data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds on surfaces that have content underneath.
Always specify text colors explicitly on hover states to guarantee contrast.
Ensure direct parent-child hierarchy in grid layouts.
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, headers, and key informational elements.
Avoid generic centered layouts, Space Grotesk font, and heavy gradients.
